note: Build inputs for Tetherow; `make fetch NAME=tetherow` puts them in place. All fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow (data/tetherow/fetch.json) on 2026-10-31. tetherow_overpass.geojson = the standard Overpass export of the box 44.012,-121.392,44.050,-121.338 (raw/overpass.geojson is also committed). dogami_dtm_ft.tif / dogami_chm_ft.tif = DOGAMI DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC / CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC, exportImage at 1 m, box x 630400-632400 / y 4875630-4877880 EPSG:32610, feet. osip2024_n/s.jpg = OSIP 2024 halves at 0.5 m (north y 4876755-4877880, south y 4875630-4876755). usgs_dem_m.tif (3DEPElevation exportImage, same box, metres) and naip_1m.jpg (USGS NAIP exportImage, same box, 1 m) are in the release as checks, not used.

files.run: python3 pipeline/intake.py ortho tetherow data/tetherow/build/osip/osip2024_n.jpg 630400 4876755 632400 4877880 {file} 630400 4875630 632400 4876755 --out raw/osip2024_05m.tif
